title: PHINIA Board Declares Quarterly Dividend of $0.30 per Common Share
summary: PHINIA Inc. (NYSE: PHIN), a diversified, industrial supplier and global leader in the development of fuel systems, electrical systems, and aftermarket solutions, today announced that its Board of Directors has declared a quarterly cash dividend in the amount of $0.30 per common share, payable on September 18, 2026, to shareholders of record at the close of business on September 4, 2026. About PHINIA PHINIA is a diversified, industrial supplier and global leader in the development of fuel systems, electrical systems, and aftermarket solutions, with a strong portfolio of trusted brands that includes DELPHI ® , DELCO REMY ® , and HARTRIDGE TM . With over 100 years of manufacturing expertise and industry relationships, PHINIA has approximately 12,500 talented employees and over 40 locations in 20 countries and is headquartered in Auburn Hills, Michigan, USA.
